name: 83×58×35 mm flanged project box · 83 × 58 × 35 mm
description: Waterproof project boxes · PVC · Opaque white (pictured) · Photographs show a white body and opaque white lid, although the retailer title describes a clear cover. The 83 × 58 × 35 mm dimensions describe the body, excluding two integral mounting ears centered on opposite short ends. Four corner lid clearance holes align with tall body posts containing brass threaded inserts. Six short floor bosses with central holes form a perimeter hexagon: one near each short end and two along each long side. Gallery image05 includes 4 mm hole callouts; screw thread, hole spacing, post dimensions and the total length including ears are not published. Listed as a two-box pack; one configuration represents one box. Waterproofing is a retailer claim without a numeric IP rating. · Delivered body measured 22 mm below the raised rim, 23.8 mm including its 1.8 mm rim; ears 6 mm. Remaining morphology is qualified reconstruction.
